title: AcademicAnalysisCandidateContract
description: Contract schema for competing candidate statistical analysis plans evaluated under the Candidate -> Falsifier -> Synthesis pattern.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the contract schema.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for this candidate (e.g. CAND-ANCOVA-01).

proposed_by.description: Agent or expert proposing the candidate (e.g. statistical-expert, methodology-expert).

method.description: Specific statistical method or model family (e.g. One-Way ANCOVA, Linear Mixed-Effects Model, RM-ANOVA, Difference-in-Differences).

research_question.description: The precise research question addressed by this candidate.

estimand.description: Explicit target parameter or causal contrast (e.g. Average treatment effect adjusted for baseline, Within-person rate of change).

assumptions.description: Mathematical and design assumptions required by the method.

data_requirements.description: Variables, sample size requirements, measurement scales, and time points needed.

diagnostics.description: Empirical diagnostic tests to assess assumption validity.

strengths.description: Key methodological advantages of this candidate for the target research question.

limitations.description: Methodological vulnerabilities, bias risks, and constraints of this candidate.

expected_interpretation.description: Scholarly narrative interpretation that results from this model without exceeding design boundaries.
